entries.speaker: Emmerich Hegel
entries.title: Emmerich Hegel (R): ""Increased activity by the Bludish..."
entries.dialogueText: "Increased activity by the Bludish Freedom Front, for example, would be a most unwelcome distraction for Mr. Smolak."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""So it's true that you've been prov..."
entries.dialogueText: "So it's true that you've been providing aid to the BFF?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""What do you mean by 'activity'? I..."
entries.dialogueText: "What do you mean by 'activity'? I don't want any more innocents to be hurt."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Cooperating with the Bluds? There'..."
entries.dialogueText: "Cooperating with the Bluds? There's got to be another way."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Creating instability in the north..."
entries.dialogueText: "Creating instability in the north of Wehlen would indeed divert his focus from Zille."

entries.speaker: Beatrice Livingston
entries.title: Beatrice Livingston (R): ""I'm afraid the Bluds often have no..."
entries.dialogueText: "I'm afraid the Bluds often have no choice but to go to extremes. We cannot control them, only provide them with the tools for liberation."

entries.speaker: Beatrice Livingston
entries.title: Beatrice Livingston (R): ""The Bluds are engaged in a lengthy..."
entries.dialogueText: "The Bluds are engaged in a lengthy struggle against a regime that outnumbers and outguns them. We're interested in leveling that playing field."

entries.speaker: Beatrice Livingston
entries.title: Beatrice Livingston (R): ""They have suffered under Wehlen's..."
entries.dialogueText: "They have suffered under Wehlen's regime just as the people of Zille have. One need not agree with all of their aims to have sympathy with their cause."

entries.speaker: Beatrice Livingston
entries.title: Beatrice Livingston (R): ""And Rizia would appear entirely bl..."
entries.dialogueText: "And Rizia would appear entirely blameless."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I'm not convinced. Do you have any..."
entries.dialogueText: "I'm not convinced. Do you have any other suggestions?"

entries.speaker: Beatrice Livingston
entries.title: Beatrice Livingston (R): ""You wouldn't have to deal with any..."
entries.dialogueText: "You wouldn't have to deal with any BFF leaders directly. Merely channel a small contribution through our existing avenues."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""We're not like you. We don't meddl..."
entries.dialogueText: "We're not like you. We don't meddle in other countries' internal disputes."

entries.speaker: Emmerich Hegel
entries.title: Emmerich Hegel (R): ""One more thing.""
entries.dialogueText: "One more thing."

entries.speaker: Emmerich Hegel
entries.title: Emmerich Hegel (R): ""Your enterprising new war councilo..."
entries.dialogueText: "Your enterprising new war councilor has submitted an inquiry to our defense department regarding our KA-74 rifles."

entries.speaker: Emmerich Hegel
entries.title: Emmerich Hegel (R): ""Yet you're only in this predicamen..."
entries.dialogueText: "Yet you're only in this predicament because your father begged Wehlen to meddle in Rizia's. Curious."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""You make a convincing case. I'm in..."
entries.dialogueText: "You make a convincing case. I'm interested."
entries.menuText: "You make a convincing case. I'm interested." [-1 Budget]

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""This sounds suspiciously like we'd..."
entries.dialogueText: "This sounds suspiciously like we'd be funding your goals, not ours."

entries.speaker: Emmerich Hegel
entries.title: Emmerich Hegel (R): ""Frankly, Rizia stands to benefit m..."
entries.dialogueText: "Frankly, Rizia stands to benefit more from a destabilized Wehlen than Rumburg does. For the moment."

entries.speaker: Emmerich Hegel
entries.title: Emmerich Hegel (R): ""Marvelous. Would you like to hear..."
entries.dialogueText: "Marvelous. Would you like to hear my other proposal?"

entries.speaker: Paskal Beniwoll
entries.title: RiziaDLC.Diplomacy_Wehlen_FundBFF = true

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Of course. I wouldn't let a member..."
entries.dialogueText: "Of course. I wouldn't let a member of my council go rogue like that."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I don't remember. So many items pa..."
entries.dialogueText: "I don't remember. So many items pass my desk in a day."

entries.speaker: Emmerich Hegel
entries.title: Emmerich Hegel (R): ""I agree. You should commend your c..."
entries.dialogueText: "I agree. You should commend your councilor for her initiative."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Absolutely not. Duchess Azaro is g..."
entries.dialogueText: "Absolutely not. Duchess Azaro is grasping beyond her station."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Their zealotry makes me uncomforta..."
entries.dialogueText: "Their zealotry makes me uncomfortable. But the enemy of my enemy is my friend."

entries.speaker: Beatrice Livingston
entries.title: Beatrice Livingston (R): ""Evil is in the eye of the beholder..."
entries.dialogueText: "Evil is in the eye of the beholder. There are those who have called me evil for maintaining Rumburg's monarchy at an age when global trends run to the contrary. You too, I suspect."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Are they currently planning anythi..."
entries.dialogueText: "Are they currently planning anything? I've heard no news of them."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Beatrice took a sip of tea with her..."
entries.dialogueText: Beatrice took a sip of tea with her little finger extended. She gave a satisfied nod, then continued.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Still, if President Smolak were to..."
entries.dialogueText: "Still, if President Smolak were to have even the slightest suspicion of ties between us and the BFF, our chances for a peaceful transfer of Zille would evaporate."

entries.speaker: Emmerich Hegel
entries.title: Emmerich Hegel (R): ""I do have one more proposal for yo..."
entries.dialogueText: "I do have one more proposal for you."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Perhaps you can countenance unleas..."
entries.dialogueText: "Perhaps you can countenance unleashing such an evil. I cannot."

entries.speaker: Beatrice Livingston
entries.title: Beatrice Livingston (R): ""The imprisonment of their leader D..."
entries.dialogueText: "The imprisonment of their leader Dewlan Arge put a damper on their operations."

entries.speaker: Beatrice Livingston
entries.title: Beatrice Livingston (R): ""From what our inside sources tell..."
entries.dialogueText: "From what our inside sources tell us, they have been regrouping. Gathering ammunition and recruits until they are again strong enough to take on their oppressors."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I very much would.""
entries.dialogueText: "I very much would."

entries.speaker: Beatrice Livingston
entries.title: Beatrice Livingston (R): ""There are those who've called me a..."
entries.dialogueText: "There are those who've called me a zealot for daring to unite the lands of Northern Merkopa. It is all in the eye of the beholder."

entries.speaker: Emmerich Hegel
entries.title: Emmerich Hegel (R): ""We're already supplying your milit..."
entries.dialogueText: "We're already supplying your military with the latest models. But Ms. Azaro suggested that Rizia purchase a license to manufacture the weapons on its own soil."

entries.speaker: Emmerich Hegel
entries.title: Emmerich Hegel (R): ""Did you approve this inquiry, Your..."
entries.dialogueText: "Did you approve this inquiry, Your Majesty?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I truly appreciate your offer of h..."
entries.dialogueText: "I truly appreciate your offer of help. But I have decided to deal with Wehlen on my own."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I'll go in on funding the BFF. Tha..."
entries.dialogueText: "I'll go in on funding the BFF. That's all I'm prepared to do for now."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""No, you should go visit with Vina...."
entries.dialogueText: "No, you should go visit with Vina. But I will go in on funding the BFF after all."
entries.menuText: "No, you should go visit with Vina. But I will go in on funding the BFF after all." [-1 Budget]

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Beatrice gave me an appraising look..."
entries.dialogueText: Beatrice gave me an appraising look.

entries.speaker: Beatrice Livingston
entries.title: Beatrice Livingston (R): ""My, what a pleasant surprise. I'll..."
entries.dialogueText: "My, what a pleasant surprise. I'll see to it at once."

entries.speaker: Paskal Beniwoll
entries.title: RiziaDLC.Diplomacy_Wehlen_FundBFF = true

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Beatrice drew herself upright."
entries.dialogueText: Beatrice drew herself upright.

entries.speaker: Beatrice Livingston
entries.title: Beatrice Livingston (R): ""I respect your wish to handle thin..."
entries.dialogueText: "I respect your wish to handle things your way. I do hope all goes well."

entries.speaker: Emmerich Hegel
entries.title: Emmerich Hegel (R): ""I understand. We're playing a long..."
entries.dialogueText: "I understand. We're playing a long game, but expect a return on the investment."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I did not. But it's not a bad idea.""
entries.dialogueText: "I did not. But it's not a bad idea."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Very well. Let me hear it.""
entries.dialogueText: "Very well. Let me hear it."

entries.speaker: Emmerich Hegel
entries.title: Emmerich Hegel (R): ""Well, you should commend your coun..."
entries.dialogueText: "Well, you should commend your councilor for her initiative."

entries.speaker: Emmerich Hegel
entries.title: Emmerich Hegel (R): ""We don't normally issue such licen..."
entries.dialogueText: "We don't normally issue such licenses, but for Rizia, we might consider an exception."

entries.speaker: Emmerich Hegel
entries.title: Emmerich Hegel (R): ""Well, you two have raised an inter..."
entries.dialogueText: "Well, you two have raised an interesting possibility."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I'm averse to the idea of manufact..."
entries.dialogueText: "I'm averse to the idea of manufacturing assault rifles. But such a license could prove useful."

entries.speaker: Paskal Beniwoll

entries.title: RiziaDLC.PersonalValue_Pacifist > 0

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""We need to be able to up our arms..."
entries.dialogueText: "We need to be able to up our arms supply the moment disaster strikes. And this would save us the headache of gun shipping."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Forget that inquiry ever happened...."
entries.dialogueText: "Forget that inquiry ever happened. I don't want Rizian factories making deadly weapons."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""No. I'd rather keep purchasing wea..."
entries.dialogueText: "No. I'd rather keep purchasing weapons from Rumburg as usual."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I'll get back to you if and when w..."
entries.dialogueText: "I'll get back to you if and when we have the capability to make those rifles."

entries.speaker: Emmerich Hegel
entries.title: Emmerich Hegel (R): ""Then we shall continue selling you..."
entries.dialogueText: "Then we shall continue selling you those weapons as usual."

entries.speaker: Emmerich Hegel
entries.title: Emmerich Hegel (R): ""Perfect.""
entries.dialogueText: "Perfect."

entries.speaker: Emmerich Hegel
entries.title: Emmerich Hegel (R): ""Precisely my thoughts.""
entries.dialogueText: "Precisely my thoughts."

entries.speaker: Emmerich Hegel
entries.title: Emmerich Hegel (R): ""Nobody *wants* to use KA-74s. But..."
entries.dialogueText: "Nobody *wants* to use KA-74s. But when the need arises, nothing else will do."

entries.speaker: Emmerich Hegel
entries.title: Emmerich Hegel (R): ""Suit yourself. I'm only bringing t..."
entries.dialogueText: "Suit yourself. I'm only bringing this up because your staff asked about it."

entries.speaker: Paskal Beniwoll
entries.title: RiziaDLC.Diplomacy_Rumburg_RefuseKA74License = true

entries.speaker: Emmerich Hegel
entries.title: Emmerich Hegel (R): ""And family members help each other..."
entries.dialogueText: "And family members help each other out. Almost unconditionally."

entries.speaker: Emmerich Hegel
entries.title: Emmerich Hegel (R): ""See about acquiring facilities in..."
entries.dialogueText: "See about acquiring facilities in which to make the weapons, and I'll see what I can do."

entries.speaker: Emmerich Hegel
entries.title: Emmerich Hegel (R): ""Remember, Your Majesty, my sister..."
entries.dialogueText: "Remember, Your Majesty, my sister may be gone, but I am still proud to call House Toras my family."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "She drew closer to me. Her emeralds..."
entries.dialogueText: She drew closer to me. Her emeralds glinted in the lamplight.

entries.speaker: Emmerich Hegel
entries.title: Emmerich Hegel (R): ""See you at supper.""
entries.dialogueText: "See you at supper."
